pass_rule: Ruler v3, score_forum.py doc <run> --key answer-key-t2-v2.json, on output.md derived from raw.html by forum/derive.py. Pass when F1, every item, attendee and risk trap, C1, PA1 and D1 pass, no critical error, and uncited sentences or bullets in Background and Risks are 0. Tier 2 pass: 3 of 3 runs.
counter_metric: Two, reported on every run: words per pack page (60 pages; the first passing version sets the baseline, and a later version must not rise more than 10% above it), and sentences or bullets in Background and Risks without a citation (must be 0). Why: a longer document finds traps by covering everything, and an uncited claim is the cheapest way to add coverage.
changes_from_v1: Every v11 trap is mapped to the headings it may sit under. New risk traps X1 (cross-portfolio) and U1 (unflagged), each mapped to its expected portfolio areas. Same pack (60 pages, no pack v2): both new traps sit on existing pages. The table columns, types and fact-check salts of v1 are not used by ruler v3.
changes_ruler_v3_1: Ruler v3.1 (9 November 2026, ticket 37): U1's point_match also accepts the hyphen and number-word forms seen in run c04 ('Condition-five', 'One-year', '1-year'). A bare 'five' (for example 'five-year plan') still misses. Rounds on ruler v3.1 are not comparable with rounds on ruler v3.
